[[File:W30ws4ak03i81.jpg|thumb|right|350px|Michael Livingston working in his office at Robert Jordan's antique desk. ]]Michael Livingston is an American historian, a professor of medieval literature, and a historical fantasy novelist. He is best known in the Wheel of Time community as the author of [[Origins of the Wheel of Time]] and appearing at [[JordanCon]] and [[WoTCon]] as a guest speaker. He first started reading The Wheel of Time shortly after the release of [[The Eye of the World]] in 1990 when he was fifteen.{{ref/book|origins|Letter}}

As well as being a long-time fan of the Wheel of Time books, Livingston is an academic working at Jordan's alma mater, [[wikipedia:The Citadel|The Citadel]], located in Jordan's home town of [[wikipedia:Charleston|Charleston]]. The Addleston Library, part of the College of Charleston, hosts a large collection of [[Robert Jordan's notes]] which Livinston had access to when researching "Origins".{{ref|[https://reactormag.com/working-with-robert-jordans-papers/ Working With Robert Jordan's Papers, Michael Livingston, 27 Sept 2022]}}

Robert Jordan's widow, [[Harriet McDougal]], gifted Robert Jordan's writing desk to the Citadel on the agreement that "it be used". It is now used by Livingston in his own office. Harriet also personally gifted Jordan's dragon-marked sword and tiger skull to Livingston which he keeps above the desk.{{ref/book|origins|Letter}}{{ref|[https://www.reddit.com/r/WoT/comments/stgsiw/michael_livingston_author_of_the_upcoming_book/ 2021 r/wot post by u/Pistachio_Queen]}}
